newsitem.title: USA: Dow Corning implant panel stands- NYT.
newsitem.headline: Dow Corning implant panel stands- NYT.

text.p: A ruling was overturned in the in the Dow Corning bankruptcy case that had called for a new committee to negotiate for women claiming damages for injuries from the company's silicone breast implants, The New York Times said.
The earlier ruling would have unraveled months of negotiations, the newspaper said.
In Thursday's edition, the paper said a federal judge in Detroit ruled the current committee could fairly represent the interests of the thousands of claimants.
The ruling reverses last year's decision by another judge that the committee must be replaced by new negotiators, all chosen from among the claimants, the newspaper said.
The article quotes Dow Corning spokesman Kevin Wiggins, who said "We haven't yet decided whether to appeal."
